A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LrcSSM work. All 17 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–C, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original LrcSSM classification results on six datasets in Tables 1–3 and original ablation results in Appendix C, Tables 7–8.

after.justification: v3 retains the original LrcSSM benchmark results in Tables 1–3 and ablation results in Appendix C, Tables 7–8.

M1.justification: The LrcSSM architecture, diagonal-Jacobian construction, equations (8)–(14), and ELK-based computation are unchanged. Appendix B.5 retains the same explicit Euler integration.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six classification datasets: Heartbeat, SelfRegulationSCP1, SelfRegulationSCP2, EthanolConcentration, MotorImagery and EigenWorms. No tasks or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same nine comparators: NRDE, NCDE, Log-NCDE, LRU, S5, Mamba, S6, LinOSS-IMEX and LinOSS-IM. Their participation in each comparison is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices B–C retain the same accuracy metric, data-splitting procedure, validation-based hyperparameter search, per-dataset configurations and fixed ablation settings.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the input/state-dependence ablation in Table 7 and complex-valued parameter analysis in Table 8. The preliminary hybrid integration-solver experiment in Appendix B.5 is also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions describe the same five random data splits and matching baseline seeds. The mean and plus/minus reporting practices in the benchmark and ablation tables are unchanged.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–3 and 7–8 and their accompanying findings match. For example, LrcSSM remains at 36.9 ± 5.3 on EthanolConcentration and 66.3 ± 18.6 average test accuracy.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same stability assumptions, Lemma 1, Theorem 1 and proofs, complexity comparison, and scaling-law reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about exact ELK updates, gradient stability, computational scaling and competitive long-sequence performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning input correlations and integration schemes remain unchanged, as do the Newton-iteration limitation and appendix qualifications concerning time inputs, solver exploration and complex-valued parameters.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same A100 80 GB hardware, training-time information, hyperparameter tables, integration timestep and dataset download links. No technical or reproducibility information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 38 reference entries are unchanged. References moving between pages 10–12 are pagination changes, not additions or removals.

P1.justification: v3 adds Daniela Rus to the author list and a funding acknowledgement for M. Farsang before the references. The scientific prose and organization of the main sections and appendices remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 redistributes the author line, increases spacing on page 9, and adjusts reference layout across pages 10–12 to accommodate the acknowledgement. Figure 1 and Tables 1–8 retain identical content and presentation.

improvement.justification: v3 adds authorship and funding information and makes limited layout adjustments. The scientific arguments, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and limitations, including all appendices, remain unchanged. These attribution and presentation edits do not establish a meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
